question: What is the State bird of Assam? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: White winged wood duck
Parrot
Swan
Owl
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is White winged wood duck

Explanation:
The state bird of Assam is the White-winged Wood Duck, scientifically known as Asarcornis scutulata. This rare species is found in the Brahmaputra Valley and surrounding wetland areas of Assam. It inhabits forest streams, ponds, and swamps. Conservation efforts are carried out by the state government and various organizations to protect this endangered bird. Other options include Parrot, Swan, and Owl, but none of these are the state bird of Assam.

question: Which is the capital city of Nagaland?  (RPF Constable 2018 (18/01/2019) Shift 1)

The old name of Kohima was Kewhira. In 1878, the British established a garrison here. Kohima is also famous for the Kohima War Cemetery from World War II.

question: Where did the first non-alignment conference take place? (RPF Constable 2018 (19/01/2019) Shift 3)
options: Belgrade
London
New York
Bandung
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Belgrade

Explanation:
The first Non-Aligned Movement (NAM) conference was held in Belgrade, the capital of Yugoslavia, in 1961. It was attended by 25 countries. The movement was founded by leaders like Jawaharlal Nehru (India), Josip Broz Tito (Yugoslavia), Gamal Abdel Nasser (Egypt), Sukarno (Indonesia), and Kwame Nkrumah (Ghana). Its main objective was to remain non-aligned with the US and Soviet blocs during the Cold War and promote the independence of developing nations. The Bandung Conference (1955) is considered a precursor to NAM, but the first formal summit was in Belgrade.

Explanation:
पहला गुटनिरपेक्ष आंदोलन (NAM) सम्मेलन 1961 में यूगोस्लाविया की राजधानी बेलग्रेड में आयोजित हुआ था। इस सम्मेलन में 25 देशों ने भाग लिया था। इस आंदोलन की स्थापना जवाहरलाल नेहरू (भारत), जोसिप ब्रोज़ टीटो (यूगोस्लाविया), गमाल अब्देल नासिर (मिस्र), सुकर्णो (इंडोनेशिया) और क्वामे नक्रूमा (घाना) जैसे नेताओं ने की थी। इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य शीत युद्ध के दौरान अमेरिकी और सोवियत गुटों से अलग रहना और विकासशील देशों की स्वतंत्रता को बढ़ावा देना था। बांडुंग सम्मेलन (1955) को NAM का पूर्ववर्ती माना जाता है, लेकिन पहला औपचारिक सम्मेलन बेलग्रेड में हुआ।
